source_version: User-provided ZIP; upstream dataset revision not recorded
limitations: Single NREL SRRL station in Golden, Colorado; does not represent Japanese local weather.
Weather labels derive from ERA5 reanalysis and are not official forecasts or direct observations.
Source archive does not record the exact upstream image-dataset revision; the provided input archive and output artifact are pinned by SHA-256.
Fixed MST (UTC-7) convention; timestamps should not be interpreted as daylight-adjusted local time.
Class proportions differ substantially among train, validation, and test splits, especially for rain.
Open-Meteo free API service access is non-commercial; this service condition is distinct from the CC BY 4.0 data license.
audit_scope: Input ZIP size/SHA, safe member paths, CRC, all image decode/dimensions, table/image correspondence, duplicates, date and split consistency, label rule, and representative visual review.
visual_review: Five representative images visually confirmed as all-sky imagery. No per-image semantic or weather-quality review.
